mapper.sql: model.id AS id, model.model_name AS model_name, model.description AS description, model.icon_id AS icon_id, icon.icon_url AS icon, model.tags::TEXT AS tags_json, model.model_name_tokens::TEXT AS model_name_tokens_json, model.description_tokens::TEXT AS description_tokens_json, model.vendor AS vendor, model.input_ratio AS input_ratio, model.cached_input_ratio AS cached_input_ratio, model.output_ratio AS output_ratio, model.is_enabled AS is_enabled, model.row_version AS row_version, model.created_at AS created_at, model.updated_at AS updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model ( id, model_name, description, icon_id, tags, model_name_tokens, description_tokens, vendor, input_ratio, cached_input_ratio, output_ratio, is_enabled ) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{iconId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, CAST(#{tagsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), CAST(#{modelNameTokensJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), CAST(#{descriptionTokensJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), #{vendor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cachedInputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{outputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{enabled,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model SET model_name = #{model.modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, description = #{model.description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, icon_id = #{model.iconId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, tags = CAST(#{model.tagsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), model_name_tokens = CAST(#{model.modelNameTokensJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), description_tokens = CAST(#{model.descriptionTokensJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), vendor = #{model.vendor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, input_ratio = #{model.inputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, cached_input_ratio = #{model.cachedInputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, output_ratio = #{model.outputRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{model.id,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND row_version = #{expectedVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_model model LEFT JOIN ai_model_icon icon ON icon.id = model.icon_id WHERE model.id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT FROM ai_model model LEFT JOIN ai_model_icon icon ON icon.id = model.icon_id WHERE model.is_enabled = TRUE ORDER BY model.id LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
